acceptance_criteria: User can authenticate via GitHub OAuth
Dashboard displays all active tasks with status
User can create, edit, and update tasks
UX is responsive and accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Real-time updates for task status changes
Error messages are user-friendly and actionable

test_cases.title: GitHub OAuth sign-in
test_cases.description: User can sign in with GitHub and receive a valid session

test_cases.title: Dashboard lists active tasks
test_cases.description: Dashboard shows all active tasks with status badges and progress

test_cases.title: Create/Edit Task
test_cases.description: User can create a task linked to a GitHub issue and edit fields

test_cases.title: Real-time updates
test_cases.description: Task status updates are reflected in real-time to other clients

test_cases.title: Access control
test_cases.description: Only authorized users can edit tasks; read-only for others

test_cases.title: Responsive layout
test_cases.description: UI renders correctly on mobile, tablet, and desktop

test_cases.title: User-friendly errors
test_cases.description: Failures show actionable messages and retry options

test_cases.title: Accessibility
test_cases.description: UI meets WCAG 2.1 AA for key flows
